name: aritra-portfolio
description: Static, accessible portfolio for Aritra Saha. No production dependencies.

scripts.lint: prettier --check index.html 404.html embedded/index.html styles.css script.js assets/*.js assets/*.css scripts/*.mjs tests/*.mjs playwright.config.mjs docs/*.md README.md package.json .github/workflows/*.yml && html-validate index.html 404.html embedded/index.html && node scripts/lint_syntax.mjs
scripts.format: prettier --write index.html 404.html embedded/index.html styles.css script.js assets/*.js assets/*.css scripts/*.mjs tests/*.mjs playwright.config.mjs docs/*.md README.md package.json .github/workflows/*.yml
